name: anvil
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away and stops an accidental cold send, docks a panel with cache, usage, subagents, auto-mode denials, your messages and git status beside the transcript, and translates Chinese drafts into English before you send them

threshold.title: 上下文阈值
threshold.description: 单位 token。上下文达到它的会话自动开启缓存保活，冷发送守卫也只拦这类会话

autoKeepalive.title: 自动开启缓存保活
autoKeepalive.description: 决定默认：开着时，上下文达到阈值的会话自动开启缓存保活；单个会话可用 /anvil keepalive 切换开关，不受这项和阈值限制

guard.title: 冷发送守卫
guard.description: 缓存已过期且上下文达到阈值时，拦下发给模型的第一条消息一次，提示重建代价

translateBackend.title: 翻译后端
translateBackend.description: haiku、sonnet 用订阅内的模型；api 用下面两项的 OpenAI 兼容接口，key 读环境变量 ANVIL_TRANSLATE_API_KEY

translateApiUrl.title: 自有 API 接口地址
translateApiUrl.description: OpenAI 兼容接口的地址，翻译后端选 api 时使用

translateApiModel.title: 自有 API 模型名
translateApiModel.description: 翻译后端选 api 时请求的模型名
